name: @resumelingo/shared
description: Type definitions for worker/ (Cloudflare Workers+Hono+D1) — DB record shapes, catalog/config value types, and auth token payloads. Not consumed by client/, which intentionally keeps its own API-facing view types (see client/src/types/index.ts). Originally shared between worker/ and a since-retired server/ (Node+Express+Postgres) parity backend; kept as its own package since worker/ still imports it as file:../shared.
